audit_findings.title: Potential levered-numerator and net-debt-bridge mismatch
audit_findings.magnitude: $1,367.654 million debt deduction ($20.77/share) implicated; 2025 interest expense was $52.737 million
audit_findings.mechanism: If OE is levered cash flow derived from net income after interest, the bridge's separate debt deduction double-counts financing claims and understates equity value.
audit_findings.evidence: Interest expense increased by $8.8 million in 2025 to $52.7 million compared to $43.9 million in 2024.
audit_findings.explanation: The bridge demonstrably deducts $1.368 billion of debt, but the supplied record does not show whether the $367.3 million OE anchor adds back after-tax interest. The error is therefore unresolved rather than demonstrated. If OE is levered, the potential $20.77/share correction is about 29% of the $71.63 base value and is material.
audit_findings.action: Trace the 2025 OE worksheet from net income through interest and taxes. Rerun either with unlevered OE plus the net-debt bridge or with levered equity cash flow and no second debt deduction.

audit_findings.title: BTY put right is a senior claim omitted from the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $27.722 million at June 30, 2026, equal to $0.42/share and 0.6% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: The redeemable NCI is a claim ahead of common equity and should be deducted in the equity bridge; improperly retaining 100% of BTY depreciation or other OE components could also overstate OE.
audit_findings.evidence: The put option, held by the noncontrolling shareholder of BTY, provides the right to sell its remaining 20 % interest in BTY to Aptar.
audit_findings.explanation: Omission of the latest filed redemption carrying amount is demonstrated, but its direct scale is only $0.42/share versus base value of $71.63 and the $58.54 gap between the bull value and market price. The separate possibility that OE contains more than Aptar's 80% economic share is not demonstrated; the filings already allocate BTY net income to redeemable NCI, and BTY is small relative to the consolidated group.
audit_findings.action: Deduct the June 2026 redemption value, obtain the shareholder formula, and trace BTY net income, depreciation, working capital and capital expenditure in the OE worksheet to confirm consistent 80% attribution.

audit_findings.title: Affiliate earnings may be capitalized and the stakes added again
audit_findings.magnitude: 2025 equity-method earnings of $7.393 million imply about $116.0 million, or $1.76/share, of base-case operating PV; stakes_net is $124.8 million
audit_findings.mechanism: Affiliate earnings included in the OE anchor are capitalized in operating value while the underlying investments are separately added through stakes_net.
audit_findings.evidence: We recognize our equity in earnings in our equity method affiliates on a one-month lag basis and record our proportionate share of each investee's net income or loss into earnings after the date of investment, the adjustment of basis difference initially recognized and the other comprehensive income allocated to us from the investee.
audit_findings.explanation: The filings demonstrate that $7.393 million of affiliate earnings entered 2025 net income and that no affiliate dividends were received, but the supplied record does not demonstrate that those earnings survived the OE adjustments or that all $124.8 million of stakes_net relates to those affiliates. Even if the full 2025 affiliate earnings were duplicated, the computed base-value effect is about 2.5%, insufficient by itself to alter the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile stakes_net by investee and trace the $7.393 million of equity earnings, taxes and basis-difference amortization through the OE worksheet; rerun after removing earnings attributable to investments retained in the bridge.

audit_findings.title: The 2025 anchor may retain a nonrecurring BTY remeasurement gain
audit_findings.magnitude: $26.518 million after the filed tax reconciliation; about $416.1 million of base operating PV, $6.32/share, and 8.8% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: A one-time remeasurement gain retained in the OE anchor is projected and capitalized as recurring operating cash flow.
audit_findings.evidence: As a result of this acquisition, we remeasured our previously held minority equity interest in BTY at fair value resulting in a pre-tax gain of $ 26.5 million recognized in Gain from remeasurement of equity method investment on our Consolidated Statements of Income.
audit_findings.explanation: The nonrecurring $26.518 million gain is demonstrated, but its inclusion in the $367.3 million anchor is unresolved because the OE worksheet is absent. The filed adjusted-income reconciliation assigns no tax to the gain. If retained, it represents 7.2% of anchor OE and inflates base intrinsic value by about $6.32/share, a material valuation distortion.
audit_findings.action: Verify that the complete $26.518 million gain was removed from 2025 OE and was not reintroduced through adjusted income; if retained, reduce the anchor and rerun all scenarios and the margin-of-safety price.

audit_findings.title: Serial restructuring costs may have been treated as one-offs
audit_findings.magnitude: $74.5 million cumulative filed cost; the filed 2025 after-tax add-back was $7.334 million, implying about $115.1 million or $1.75/share of base value
audit_findings.mechanism: Adding recurring restructuring costs back to OE raises the anchor and may distort historical growth, although the latest-actual anchor rule limits the effect of older adjustments.
audit_findings.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, we recognized $ 9.8 million, $ 13.0 million and $ 45.4 million, respectively, of restructuring costs related to our initiative to better leverage our fixed cost base through growth and cost reduction measures.
audit_findings.explanation: Three consecutive years of charges demonstrate recurrence, but the record does not show whether the OE series added them back. Because the $367.3 million latest actual, rather than the higher $399 million trend, sets the anchor, prior-year adjustments do not currently raise the anchor through the trend calculation. Even if the entire filed 2025 after-tax adjustment were reversed, base value would decline only about 2.4%, which is not material to the conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Inspect all restructuring, acquisition and litigation adjustments in the OE series; retain the 2025 charge or replace it with an evidenced recurring annual burden, then confirm that the latest-actual anchor remains binding.

audit_findings.title: Unfunded retirement claims are outside the debt-only bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $15.619 million aggregate net pension deficit at December 31, 2025 ($0.24/share); June 2026 retirement and deferred-compensation liabilities were $66.143 million before unspecified asset offsets ($1.00/share)
audit_findings.mechanism: Net unfunded pension and supplemental-retirement obligations are senior claims that reduce the equity bridge; understated recurring pension funding could also overstate OE.
audit_findings.evidence: The liability for this plan, which is not funded, was $ 16.2 million and $ 14.2 million at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The bridge omits pension claims, but the latest complete funded-status disclosure shows only a $15.619 million aggregate net deficit after offsetting domestic plan surpluses and foreign deficits. Even the June 2026 liability balance before asset offsets equals only about 1.4% of base equity value. The exact June net funded position remains unresolved, but the filed scale is not sufficient to change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June 2026 plan assets, PBOs and SERP balance, separate deferred compensation from pension amounts, deduct the net unfunded claim not already captured in OE, and verify that expected contributions are treated consistently.
